name: quick-image-board
description: 本地优先的桌面图片临时画布与分类工具

scripts.dev: concurrently -k "vite --host 127.0.0.1" "npm run build:electron && wait-on http://127.0.0.1:5173 && cross-env NODE_ENV=development node_modules/electron/dist/electron.exe ."
scripts.build: npm run build:renderer && npm run build:electron
scripts.test: npm run build:electron && node --test tests/storage.test.mjs tests/ui-surface.test.mjs tests/windows-clipboard.test.mjs tests/window-geometry.test.mjs tests/window-main.test.mjs tests/shared-boundary.test.mjs tests/shared-geometry.test.mjs
